meaning.en: the great Lord Vishnu
marked by being, awareness, and bliss
having seen Ramachandra
beautiful in every limb
the sages living in the forest
became struck with wonder
they said to him
the blameless one among avatars
let us embrace you
in another life, in the Krishna incarnation
you having become cowherd girls
you shall embrace me
the other incarnations that there are

meaning.en: those are indeed cowherd men, not women

meaning.hi: हम आने वाले अवतार के वचन को थामते हैं
